Samir —

Quick note as we finalize the ACME/BrightWorks demo next week. The VP that Samir mentioned joining (thanks again for confirming) has a narrow on-site window and travel that looks likely to collide with our scheduled 60-min slot on Thu 20 May at 10:00 PT. Before we push things broadly, wanted to propose a compact plan that keeps the VP engagement without losing technical depth:

- Option A: Split the session — 25-minute exec-focused briefing at 10:00 (VP attends first 20) + separate 40-minute deep dive at 11:00 with Karthik leading.
- Option B: Keep a single 45-minute slot earlier (09:30 PT) to catch the VP before their transit.
- Option C: Keep current time; VP join for first 10–15 minutes only, then handoff to Karthik/Vanessa.

Can you check which of these is least disruptive for the VP? If none work, we’ll propose 09:30 or move to Fri depending on availability. I’ve attached an updated agenda (v2) that maps the exec ask to a 25-min briefing if we go for Option A.

Vanessa / Karthik — if VP joins only for the first block, can you confirm who will run the deeper technical section and who will take follow-up action items?

Thanks,
Jonas
